audience: marketing and web teams that manage product images and banners in ImageKit

useCases.title: Find media files by filter or path
useCases.text: Search the media library with a filter, such as tags, names or creation dates. Read the details and URLs of a file you pick.

useCases.title: Add or remove tags on many files
useCases.text: Add tags to up to 100 files at once, or remove tags from them. Existing tags stay when you add a tag.

useCases.title: Upload an image from a public URL
useCases.text: Upload a file from a public URL or a base64 string to the media library. Each call creates a new file. It does not overwrite a file by default.

useCases.title: Publish, move or rename a file
useCases.text: Publish or unpublish a file, or replace its tags. Moving or renaming a file changes its path, so old links stop working.

useCases.title: Read metadata of a remote image
useCases.text: Read the EXIF and technical metadata of a public image URL, without an upload. Check the status of a CDN purge request.
